paragraphs.text: Man is an unreleased acorn species for creatures who are partially human .

Man was a creature type that was designed for Unglued 2: The Obligatory Sequel before it was canceled. It was for a card called Poodleboy which represented a legendary Dog Man, a humanoid poodle. Poodleboy had previously appeared in an old commercial for Magic: The Gathering .
Normally human hybrids in the Multiverse would just use the human type in addition to their other type so a card like Poodleboy would just be printed as Dog Human.
